quest.title: Mineral Research: Icy Pebbles
quest.description: A large number of Icy Pebbles are scattered along the western coast of Hiisi Island...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Icy Pebble x15

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: During my years at sea, I once heard a call coming from nowhere. The others didn't react at all, but I was captivated almost instantly.

dialogues.speaker: Auni
dialogues.text: It must have been a voice from another world. I've heard it too.

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: Only later did I realize... That call carried with it every dream that never made it to the far shore. You might even call it a gathering of regrets.

dialogues.speaker: Auni
dialogues.text: You should bring an Icy Pebble with you. Look through the hole at its center, and you'll see who's been calling out to you.

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: But back then, I was still a hot-headed young fool. Even danger looked like an opportunity to me. So I charged straight in without a second thought.

dialogues.speaker: Auni
dialogues.text: They say the hole at the center of the Icy Pebble is a gateway to another world... But how exactly are you supposed to cross through it?

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: And after that... the sea and its raging winds took everything from me — my wealth, my honor, and even my family.

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: Adventures driven by ambition and desire never end well.

dialogues.speaker: Auni
dialogues.text: Ah, it's stuck...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Let me help you get that off. And next time, try not to do that again, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Auni
dialogues.text: Linnea! What brings you back here?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: I've been collecting Icy Pebbles nearby. I saw you chatting and thought I'd come say hello.

dialogues.speaker: Auni
dialogues.text: Oh! Maybe you could really use an Icy Pebble to open a gateway to another world, Linnea! If anyone could pull it off, it would be you...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Even I can't do that. Didn't I tell you before? That's just a folk tale people stitched together. There's no solid evidence behind it.

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: Ugh... Looks like this isn't gonna work.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: ...Oh. So you were listening.

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: Ahem... no. I'm not the person I used to be anymore. These days, I'm content with what I have, and I want nothing else.

dialogues.speaker: Auni
dialogues.text: What a pity. Then I'll help you collect Icy Pebbles too, Linnea.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: That'd be great!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: With Auni's help, the materials were soon collected...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Thank you, but I've already gathered everything I need.

dialogues.speaker: Auni
dialogues.text: Alright then. I'll head to Moleyvalley to see Grandpa Moley and the others. See you later!

talks.objective: Head to the designated location to investigate

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Linnea quickly makes the necessary preparations for the investigation...

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: (test) Voice Line

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: Oh, this calm stretch of sea... It's the final resting place for wanderers like us.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (There seems to be something nearby worth examining. <color=#FFCC33FF>Linnea</color>, with her deep knowledge of the local ecology, might find something useful...)

dialogues.speaker: Auni
dialogues.text: Hmm, I should head to Moleyvalley to find Grandpa Moley and the others later...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (There are quite a few Icy Pebbles around here. I should collect some and take a closer look.)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (Hmm? Is that Auni? Should I go say hello first?)

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: The sea...

dialogues.speaker: Auni
dialogues.text: A gateway to another world...
